source_provenance: Each Markdown file must retain source_relative_path and source_sha256 in front matter.
rules: One section_content source page maps to one Markdown file by default.
Use lowercase ASCII kebab-case derived from displayed number/title; preserve source numbering as a prefix when detected.
Place active_candidate under corpus/active/, deferred_candidate under corpus/deferred/, reference under corpus/reference/, and reference_solution under corpus/reference_solution/.
Put chapter landings in their chapter directory as index.md; map the frontmatter landing to corpus/reference/frontmatter/index.md; map index and backmatter explicitly under corpus/reference/.
Retain assets by provenance; do not rename source assets during initial conversion.
